content: Ukal uboo a pɛɛlà
Làläb Nzam, ntɔn bɛ làbà baan ukwen nde.
Làkäl unsà ukwen, asànaa Klistɔ kikwen nde anà kàpɛ nde mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ŋakwo akà Nzam ntɔn bi, asànaa an'kab anà ibɔɔn asànaa may a usɔŋ aŋàbwaŋ.
Itàkal ipasàsɛ, ŋingyäy ifà ifà, ngyal a indiir byanswà, ikal anki akà ikikye uboo a bɛ, ya ikal abun sye ntɔn aŋin'kyɛɛl.
Kà yà ubwaŋ anki mutɛn indiir inaŋ anà unsil itàkal itetɛɛn, wɛɛ yà ubwaŋ mufuur an'tɔɔn taaŋ lanswà.
Ntɔn, làyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa mbuur wanswà afàkyer ipasàsɛ, ndaa a nswɛn itàkal unkaam - ikaswaŋà naa itɛk - usàwal anki kwal unsà Imwol a Klistɔ anà kyà Nzam.
Akà mbuur mwɛy twon kàmàlakur unsà ndaa a bunàbun: ntɔn indiir abi byàfàkàwool nkyɛl a Nzam udu a aŋin'tswe ngwal.
Abun, twon lan'tüüb a baar a tub abà.
Itaan, bɛ làkälà u làpib, wɛɛ ŋàbawà bɛ làbà pɛɛlà amu Mwol. Làkäl asànaa baan a pɛɛlà.
Ntɔn imbɛŋ a pɛɛlà kyà: ubwaŋ, balàbal anà ndandaa.
Làsɔ̈ɔ̈l ndaa ifàpà un'sak akà Mwol.
Twon lan'bilà unsà isal a mpib ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ, wɛɛ làtwey bya u leŋ.
Ntɔn indiir bàfàkyer baar abà u nku, yà nswɛn musam bya.
Wɛɛ indiir byanswà ufàmɛɛy pɛɛlà, byàfàmɛnà kà ipöl,
ntɔn undiir aŋàmɛɛy wanswà wà pɛɛlà. Kyakin bàfàtɛn naa:

content.text: waa Klistɔ usàtà inyäŋ amu ngye. »

content: Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ unsà nkääl abɛ, twon lan'mɛnà asànaa bɛ làbà insil, wɛɛ làkäl baar a an'yeerà,
abà bàfàsyääl taaŋ alà ubwaŋ, ntɔn ilä byà ibe.
Abun, twon lan'kal asànaa baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n un'yɛnà, wɛɛ làyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa ukwen a Mwol bà aben.
Twon lan'yɔr man, ma màfàbwiy baar ndwaŋ. Wɛɛ làkäl aŋàyɔl a Dweelà.
Làlɛɛl bɛ a bɛ u mbwo a an'diim a nsyäŋà anà an'diim a ikwɛŋ. Làtɔ̈l an'diim anà lun'syäŋà Mwol u mpem abɛ wanswà.
Utaaŋ lanswà, ntɔn indiir byanswà, làfuur an'tɔɔn àkà Nzam Taa kà ikɔb a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Akyay anà adim
Bɛ baar làfàpà Klistɔ làzir, làkäl unsà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n bɛ a bɛ.
Akaar, lawem adim abɛ asànaa làfàwem bɛ Mwol.
Ntɔn un'dim wà mfum a un'kaar, asànaa Klistɔ awà nde Mfum a Ikööŋ, nde wà un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a Ikööŋ akyà ndür ande ŋakwo.
Wɛɛ, asànaa Ikööŋ ifàsà kya Klistɔ làkoo, wɛy akaar sye bàwem adim aba unsà ndaa yanswà.
Adim, lakwen akyay abɛ asànaa Klistɔ kàkwen nde Ikööŋ anà kàpɛ nde mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ŋakwo ntɔn kya.
Abà, nde kàkwen mubuul kya kyà in'kyɛɛl anà mupöŋ kya u mbwo a an'dà anà u mbwo a Ndaa.
Nde kàkwen naa kya ikäl asànaa nde ŋakwo, ntsà, ukɔɔn kitwan, itàkal un'bɔɔ, itàkal too làmwɛy. Nde kàkwen naa Ikööŋ ande ikäl kyà in'kyɛɛl anà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n an'pɛl.
Undiiràwun, un'dim akyer akwen un'kyay ande asànaa ndür ande ŋakwo. Mbuur afàkwen un'kyay ande, afàkwen sye nde ŋakwo.
Ntɔn, akà mbuur mwɛy watɛy afàyiiŋ ndür ande ŋakwo, wɛɛ nde akyer afàdii anà afàlɔɔn ya ubwaŋàbwaŋ asànaa ufàkyer Klistɔ ntɔn Ikööŋ ande.
Nkye bi kà ibà itiir a ndür ande anki?
« Kyakin baal asàwɛy taarànde anà ngwän, waa usàkàbääb anà un'kyay ande. Ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàbulà ndür mwɛy. »
Ngyee ayi yà yàkölàköl: mɛ, mɛ an'tɛn naa ya yà ntɔn Klistɔ anà Ikööŋ.
Itàkal naa abà, wɛy mbuur mbuur uboo a bɛ ukwen un'kyay ande asànaa nde ŋakwo, wɛy un'kaar upɛ un'dim ande làzir.
